Saffron Mesh Synchronizer Guide (English)

The Saffron synchronizer switches to fallback beacon mode after five lost beacons.

The Saffron desktop utility provides a quiet-hours toggle that mutes non-critical buzzers.

Operational note 1 for saffron-en (beacon-schedule): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for saffron-en across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for beacon-schedule, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Battery Backup Behavior

On auxiliary battery power, Saffron preserves timing accuracy for up to 14 hours.
